title: Russell first hears Hamilton in a pickup band
summary: Russell recalls first hearing Hamilton in a pickup band with Jim Robinson, then later on Bourbon Street with George Lewis.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: I think I heard you the first time, it was across the river, along the west we go, along that road that goes up the river, with Ezreal Gorman one night, and Jim Robinson. I don't know, it wasn't anybody's special, organized band, it just happened to be a pickup band, but that's the first time I ever saw you and got to hear you. Then I didn't hear you for a few years, until you were here on Bourbon Street with George and all that. Yeah. I believe.
